verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party documentation of a compatibility promise, such as a v1.x compatibility guarantee, and no version upgrade guides. Two items come close but earn no credit. Terraform tests (terraform-docs-7) check users' own module changes for breaking changes, which is an adjacent feature, not a release compatibility promise. Community notes about upgrading smoothly or backing up state before upgrades are anecdotes and user-side workarounds.
